notes: Agent runtime scenarios. Each scenario is one conversation of one API end user; turns run in order, and a turn that follows a question from the Agent is sent as the answer to it. expect applies to the last turn and to facts collected over the whole conversation; turn_expect applies to single turns by index. Every turn also gets the default checks in run.py: it completes, reports no error, gives a non-empty answer in the scenario's language, and names no internal tool. answer_values compares numbers with thousands separators removed, within tolerance (default 0.005). observe marks scenarios that are reported but not scored.
